title: YouTube Marketing for Local Businesses: Key Stats
source: YouTube Creator Blog (2023), HubSpot (2023), Wyzowl (2023), WordStream (2023)

bars.label: 68% of YouTube Viewers Use Platform for Local Discovery
62% Consumers Prefer Businesses Seen on YouTube
2.70 Dollars - Average Cost Per Click (YouTube Ads)
70% of viewers watch videos on mobile devices

narration: This chart highlights key statistics demonstrating the effectiveness of YouTube marketing for local businesses.  A significant 68% of YouTube viewers use the platform to discover local businesses, and 76% research products and services before purchasing.  Furthermore, a recent survey found that 62% of consumers are more likely to buy from a business they’ve seen on YouTube.  These figures illustrate YouTube’s potential to drive local sales and build brand awareness.
